description: Create a payment link for the daily observation of domains, as a yearly or monthly subscription: from admission, within five working days of payment, two independent witnesses record each domain every day in full (homepage and the machine-readable files), seal each day and anchor it externally; the admission is entered in the public record. The customer pays for the measurement, not for a document: the data in hand is an evidence extract (order_extract). A domain already observed daily in the core is refused by name, because it costs nothing. On cancellation the subscription ends with the paid period and everything witnessed until then stays sealed. This call charges nothing; the subscription starts only after a person has paid on the returned page. Fees and tiers: https://machinewitness.eu/services

domains.description: Domain names, one to 500, e.g. example.eu.

email.description: Address for confirmations, prefilled on the payment page. Optional.

language.description: Language of the payment page and the e-mails. Default en.

name: order_observation
title: Subscribe domains to daily observation
